name: isitdone
title_zh: 说「改完了」之前先跑一遍真测试并留下回执
tagline_zh: 受够了「测试已通过」其实根本没跑？它在你改完的那份工作区上真跑仓库自带的 test、typecheck、lint。
tagline_en: Tired of "tests pass" that were never run? It executes the repo's own test, typecheck and lint on your exact.
desc_en: Prove a coding task is actually done before saying so. Runs the repository's real test, typecheck and lint commands on the exact working tree, writes a git-bound receipt, and reports NOT DONE with the failing output when anything fails. Use it before claiming "tests pass", before opening a PR, at the end of any task that changed code, or when a user asks you to verify your work.
why_zh: 回执绑死在具体 commit 和工作区状态上，换一行代码就作废，所以它证明的是「这一刻真的过了」。
why_en: The receipt is bound to an exact commit and working-tree state, so it proves this moment passed, not that you remember it passing.
limit_zh: 仓库里得真有可跑的 test/typecheck/lint 命令，没有就无从验证；它只回答「过没过」，不修代码。
limit_en: Needs real runnable test/typecheck/lint commands in the repo; it only answers pass/fail, never fixes code or judges test quality, and outputs a.
title_en: Run the real tests and leave a git-bound receipt before.
